daemonVitestSummary.boundary: No all-tests-zero-skip claim; mailbox/authority/type/package steps have separate successful outcomes.

privacy: Platform request/response envelopes remain private. Compressed copies contain exact decoded logs and were signature screened; only test-title prose matched Bearer candidates. This is bounded screening, not an assertion about all possible private-data patterns.
boundaries: Nine companion workflows are terminal success. The E2B additive PR test does not publish or exercise its subscription release gate.
BrowserGate is an echo-only protected-name job. The old Production build and browser interactions job is the PG aggregate, owned by a different reader.
Linux desktop smoke and isolated community-image checks are distinct from Apple Silicon Native acceptance and production ACME model cases.
UI policy strict aggregate was not created in this snapshot and still depends on Native; no overall-main-CI pass is claimed.
